newsitem.title: FRANCE: Generale des Eaux Q1 sales up seven pct.
newsitem.headline: Generale des Eaux Q1 sales up seven pct.

text.p: Generale des Eaux said in a statement on Thursday that its first quarter sales were 39.6 billion francs ($6.9 billion), which was a seven percent increase on a like-for-like basis and at unchanged exchange rates.

In France, sales were up by 4.2 percent to 26.9 billion. The company said sales of the water services division were up 1.5 percent. energy was up 2.1 percent, waste management up 7.9 percent and transport was 6.4 percent higher.
In communication, sales were up by 48 percent to 2.3 billion francs.
But in building and public works, sales were down 6.4 percent.
Abroad, sales were up by 14 percent to 12.7 billion francs.
